_comment: Cookie Run OvenBreak — auto Send-Life to friends (Friends tab, home screen). Precondition: sit on home with the Friends tab already selected (default tab) so the leaderboard/friends list with per-row Send-Life icons is visible. Loop: scan for any visible green Send-Life icon -> tap it -> confirm the 'Send <name> a free Life?' dialog -> confirm the 'Message sent!' popup -> back to scan. When no icon is visible, swipe the list up to reveal more rows and re-scan; if still nothing after the swipe, the list is exhausted -> stop. All coords verified live @1920x1080.

scan._note: Look for ANY visible Send-Life icon (green pill, heart+mail glyph) among the currently rendered rows — matchTemplate finds whichever instance scores highest, so it doesn't matter which row. Already-sent rows show a green CHECK instead (different glyph, won't match). Tap it via tap_template so we hit the icon wherever it sits on screen.

peel_popups._note: No Send-Life icon visible — before deciding the list is exhausted, rule out a popup covering it. Cookie Run drops modals at any time, not just at launch (Daily Check-in, Power+ Treasure Rewards, Congratulations/level-up rewards, friend-info), and any of them hides the friends list. Each popup peels to its own confirm and the list is still underneath, so we return to scan (not home). This is a mini modal chain: dailycheckin(OK 965,985) -> treasure(Confirm 960,850) -> congrats(Confirm 954,847) -> levelup(Confirm 954,847). None present -> genuinely no icon on screen -> scroll_list. Shared templates/coords with boxrun_ep3.json.

peel_treasure._note: Power+ Treasure Rewards popup. Confirm (960,850) -> scan. Absent -> peel_congrats.

peel_congrats._note: Congratulations! / reward popup (also covers level-up rewards — same green Confirm button). Confirm (954,847) -> scan. Absent -> no popup at all -> scroll_list to look for more rows.

confirm_dialog._note: 'Send <name> a free Life? (+3 Gift Points)' dialog. Detect via the name-agnostic '(+3 Gift Points)' line (a per-friend name crop would only match one friend). Tap Confirm (1189,687 — CV verified, green/right) — NEVER Cancel, this loop's whole purpose is to send. If the dialog didn't actually open (e.g. a stray double-match), fall through to message_sent/scan via absent so we don't get stuck.

message_sent._note: 'Message sent!' confirmation popup. Tap its Confirm (957,685) to close, returning to the friends list with that row now showing a green check instead of the send icon. Then back to scan for the next one.

scroll_list._note: No Send-Life icon visible in the current viewport — either all visible rows are already sent/checked/OFF, or we've scrolled past them. Swipe the list up (reveal lower rows) then re-scan. A run of consecutive already-handled rows (checks + gift-OFF friends) can span MANY screens back to back, so a single swipe-and-recheck is not enough evidence of bottom-of-list -> chain into scroll_retry, which keeps swiping (up to 6 total attempts) before concluding we're truly at the bottom. Each swipe is a fresh attempt, so a long OFF-streak just costs a few extra swipes instead of a false stop.

scroll_retry_1._note: Recheck after swipe #1. Found -> resume scanning. Still absent -> swipe again (attempt #2) rather than giving up — long OFF/checked streaks need several swipes to clear.

scroll_retry_4._note: Swipe attempt #5. If this and the next both miss, a swipe is producing no further list movement (the list itself has stopped scrolling, not just a long OFF-streak) -> genuinely at the bottom.

scroll_retry_5._note: Swipe attempt #6 (final). Still nothing after 6 consecutive swipes -> the list has stopped moving -> bottom of the friends list reached -> stop.
